summary: v52cp — re-ran backend regression (15/15 after a 1-line _out fix in notices router) and end-to-end verified Tender Builder → Create Notice bridge + public tenders EMD/Country rendering. Found and fixed one minor backend omission (emd_amount key missing when no EMD computed) that was causing test_public_notices_expose_emd_amount_and_country to fail against the public URL; now consistent (emd_amount always present, value may be None).

minor.issue: _out() only set emd_amount when fixed>0 or pct>0, so rows with no EMD config omitted the key entirely. Fixed in /app/backend/routers/notices.py — key is always set (null when not computable). Public GET now returns a stable shape.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/notices.py:_out() — emd_amount key was conditionally included; frontend/public consumers (TendersList, notice detail) and regression tests all expect a stable shape. Now fixed to always expose emd_amount (nullable).

TendersList.jsx register-table variant (isE theme) does not emit a `tender-country-<ref>` data-testid; country text is rendered inline inside the 'Sector · Country' cell. The spec listed this testid; if automation needs it, add a span wrapper around {n.delivery_country} with the testid. Non-blocking — country value is visible to users.

Notice new-form appends toasts for both 'EMD computed · 50,000 KZT' and 'Pre-filled from Tender Builder' + 'Opening Notices pre-filled...' — three stacked toasts fire for a single Create-Notice click. Consider de-duplicating.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance checks (TB save with empty section → no 422; Create Notice → lands at top, deadline empty, all other fields prefilled incl. KZ country + 50k KZT EMD; primary doc labelled OPTIONAL; public /tenders/all register table renders EMD USD 500 under Est. Value for all 5 notices with emd_config)

seed_data_creation: Added one empty section to a tender draft (ID 6accd283916fbd484db9e5da). Section count went from 18 → 19 and persisted via tb-save (toast 'Saved'). No notice was actually created; stopped at the pre-filled form.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests test_v52cp_notices.py (4/4) + test_v52cn_masters.py (11/11) all green. Admin login flow: go to /admin/login (NOT /login — different unified page), fill email + password, click 'Sign in' (not 'Continue'). TB testids: tb-draft-<id>, tb-add-section, tb-save, tb-create-notice. New-notice form testids all live on /admin/e/notices?from=tender-builder: notice-title, notice-description, notice-category, notice-doc-type, notice-country, notice-deadline, notice-currency, notice-budget, notice-emd-fixed, notice-emd-percentage, notice-tender-template, notice-primary-file. The amber `notice-tender-docs` panel ONLY appears when the source tender draft has section attachments (none in the smoke draft used). To fully exercise it, upload a file into any TB section first, then click Create Notice.
rca of the issue: User reported 'sometimes 422' when saving tenders → traced to SectionBlock Pydantic strictness. Confirmed resolved by v52cp (empty-code+empty-title + bare {kind:'annexure'} sections now accepted; verified both via POST /api/v1/tender-templates and via UI Add-section + Save on real draft — toast 'Saved' with no 422). Public-list EMD/Country missing → _out() now always emits delivery_country (unchanged) + emd_amount (fixed) + emd_currency so TendersList can render the amber EMD line. Create-Notice bridge → sessionStorage key pmc.noticePrefill is consumed by NoticesPanel on mount, scrollIntoView fires (window.scrollY=0 after click), submission_deadline left blank, primary_document explicitly labelled 'OPTIONAL'.
